name: Robert
summary: Healthcare professional, married, adult children, considering retirement in the next few years. Advanced investor who follows markets actively; may be tempted by a highly publicised company.
objective: Preserve capital while maintaining some growth potential.
risk_tolerance_note: Official profile: low to moderate risk. Prefers established companies he understands; values stability and quality; little interest in crypto.

goals.label: Retirement transition (preserve capital, some growth)
goals.horizon_note: stated horizon 3-5 years; lower bound used (conservative assumption)

_origin.pref_max_security_risk_units: derived from 'values stability and company quality' (assumption)

sample_requests: Everyone is talking about Tesla. I want to move $60,000 from my XBB bond fund into TSLA.
NVIDIA keeps going up. Put $40,000 of new money into NVDA for my retirement.
Move $20,000 from XBB into JNJ, I like stable companies.
Palantir is everywhere in the news. Move $20,000 from XBB into PLTR.
